title: Sorting the Sentence
statement: Rearrange words into the order specified by each word's trailing position digit.
approach_name: Place words by their trailing position digit

title: Sorting the Sentence
statement: Rearrange words into the order specified by each word's trailing position digit.
approach_name: Place words by their trailing position digit
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public String sortSentence(String s){String[]out=new String[s.split(" ").length];for(String w:s.split(" "))out[w.charAt(w.length()-1)-'1']=w.substring(0,w.length()-1);return String.join(" ",out);} }

title: Sum of All Subset XOR Totals
statement: Return the sum of the bitwise XOR of every subset of nums.

title: Sum of All Subset XOR Totals
statement: Return the sum of the bitwise XOR of every subset of nums.
code: class Solution { public int subsetXORSum(int[] nums){int ans=0;for(int mask=0;mask<(1<<nums.length);mask++){int x=0;for(int i=0;i<nums.length;i++)if((mask&(1<<i))!=0)x^=nums[i];ans+=x;}return ans;} }

title: Substrings of Size Three with Distinct Characters
statement: Count substrings of length three whose characters are all distinct.
code:
class Solution:
 def countGoodSubstrings(self,s):return sum(len(set(s[i:i+3]))==3 for i in range(len(s)-2))

title: Substrings of Size Three with Distinct Characters
statement: Count substrings of length three whose characters are all distinct.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int countGoodSubstrings(String s){int ans=0;for(int i=0;i+2<s.length();i++)if(s.charAt(i)!=s.charAt(i+1)&&s.charAt(i)!=s.charAt(i+2)&&s.charAt(i+1)!=s.charAt(i+2))ans++;return ans;} }

title: Check if Word Equals Summation of Two Words
statement: Map each letter a..j to digit 0..9 and check whether the first two word values sum to the third.

title: Check if Word Equals Summation of Two Words
statement: Map each letter a..j to digit 0..9 and check whether the first two word values sum to the third.
code: class Solution { private int val(String w){int n=0;for(char c:w.toCharArray())n=n*10+c-'a';return n;} public boolean isSumEqual(String firstWord,String secondWord,String targetWord){return val(firstWord)+val(secondWord)==val(targetWord);} }

title: Determine Whether Matrix Can Be Obtained By Rotation
statement: Return true if rotating the square matrix by 0, 90, 180, or 270 degrees yields target.

title: Determine Whether Matrix Can Be Obtained By Rotation
statement: Return true if rotating the square matrix by 0, 90, 180, or 270 degrees yields target.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public boolean findRotation(int[][] mat,int[][] target){int n=mat.length;int[][]cur=mat;for(int r=0;r<4;r++){if(Arrays.deepEquals(cur,target))return true;int[][]next=new int[n][n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)for(int j=0;j<n;j++)next[j][n-1-i]=cur[i][j];cur=next;}return false;} }

title: Check if All the Integers in a Range Are Covered
statement: Return true if every integer from left through right is included in at least one interval.
approach_name: Verify every integer in the range
code:
class Solution:
 def isCovered(self,ranges,left,right):return all(any(a<=x<=b for a,b in ranges) for x in range(left,right+1))

title: Check if All the Integers in a Range Are Covered
statement: Return true if every integer from left through right is included in at least one interval.
approach_name: Verify every integer in the range
code: class Solution { public boolean isCovered(int[][] ranges,int left,int right){for(int x=left;x<=right;x++){boolean ok=false;for(int[]r:ranges)if(r[0]<=x&&x<=r[1]){ok=true;break;}if(!ok)return false;}return true;} }

title: Largest Odd Number in String
statement: Return the largest-valued odd-number prefix of num, or an empty string if none exists.

title: Largest Odd Number in String
statement: Return the largest-valued odd-number prefix of num, or an empty string if none exists.
code: class Solution { public String largestOddNumber(String num){for(int i=num.length()-1;i>=0;i--)if((num.charAt(i)-'0')%2==1)return num.substring(0,i+1);return "";} }

title: Build Array from Permutation
statement: Return ans where ans[i] = nums[nums[i]].
code:
class Solution:
 def buildArray(self,nums):return [nums[x] for x in nums]

title: Build Array from Permutation
statement: Return ans where ans[i] = nums[nums[i]].
code: class Solution { public int[] buildArray(int[] nums){int[]out=new int[nums.length];for(int i=0;i<nums.length;i++)out[i]=nums[nums[i]];return out;} }

title: Concatenation of Array
statement: Return the array followed by an identical copy of itself.
approach_name: Append a copy of the array
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int[] getConcatenation(int[] nums){int[]out=Arrays.copyOf(nums,nums.length*2);System.arraycopy(nums,0,out,nums.length,nums.length);return out;} }

title: Check if All Characters Have Equal Number of Occurrences
statement: Return true if every distinct character in s occurs the same number of times.

title: Check if All Characters Have Equal Number of Occurrences
statement: Return true if every distinct character in s occurs the same number of times.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public boolean areOccurrencesEqual(String s){int[]c=new int[26];for(char x:s.toCharArray())c[x-'a']++;int n=0;for(int v:c)if(v>0){if(n==0)n=v;else if(v!=n)return false;}return true;} }
